faq.label: FAQ
faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Answers to the questions on your mind.

delivery.question: How long does an app take?
delivery.answer: A simple MVP is typically delivered in 6-10 weeks. Complex apps can take 3-6 months. We provide a custom timeline after the discovery call.

pricing.question: How much does a mobile app cost?
pricing.answer: Varies by features, platform (iOS/Android/both) and backend requirements. Transparent proposal after a free call.

revisions.question: Can I change my mind during development?
revisions.answer: Since we work in sprints, small changes can be incorporated into each sprint. Major scope changes are evaluated separately.

maintenance.question: Do you provide post-launch maintenance?
maintenance.answer: Yes. We maintain compatibility with iOS and Android updates. Ongoing support through monthly maintenance packages.

migration.question: Can you rewrite an existing app?
migration.answer: Yes. We rewrite apps built with legacy technologies using modern React Native or native technologies.

mobile.question: If I have a website, why do I need an app?
mobile.answer: Push notifications, offline functionality, access to device features like camera and GPS, and higher user engagement all require a native app.
